scope: Selected B first batch: one linen-shade lamp, fitted throw and cushion, rounded rug and lighting/material refinements; no publication

method.runtime: Shared Node 24.14.0, existing Playwright and system Chrome / ANGLE Metal M1 Pro. No runtime or dependency installation.
method.script: Unchanged scripts/measure-performance.mjs through local measure.mjs. Dev server 5173, reduced motion, DPR1, CPU1x, clear simulated weather, no birds/vessels, default warm 50% room light.
method.dayNight: 1280x800, scene time 2026-10-31 12:00 and 22:00. Each before and after group contains three serial five-second samples.
method.phone: 390x844, low quality, scene time 2026-10-31 22:00, one five-second sample before and after. Mac browser size emulation, not a physical phone.
method.isolation: GPU QA and measurements run serially; application source frozen within each sample group. After group protected from idle sleep with a temporary caffeinate assertion.
method.limits: Short samples near display refresh cannot establish speedup or net GPU cost. CPU submission is not GPU completion. No Safari, physical phone, long-term thermal/battery or GPU memory validation.

resourceChanges.description: Three static lamp meshes and three textile meshes; rounded rug replaces old mesh. Shared 256x256 linen atlas. One extra unshadowed point light adds per-fragment lighting work; unchanged program counts do not imply zero GPU cost.

initializationOptimization.timingLimits: Each textile-only timing is one instrumented initialization, separate from the three-run whole-page loading comparisons.
initializationOptimization.method: A temporary 32x32 projected index of static chair triangles answers vertical and front-back contact with barycentric interpolation, replacing repeated whole-mesh raycasts. Indexes are local to authoring and are not retained in the scene or updated per frame.
initializationOptimization.verification: 646 sampled queries against an independent THREE.Raycaster over transformed sphere/box and back-sided plane fixtures, plus actual chair/cloth support and six full cat responses in both desktop and phone browser tests.

environment.note: Runtime platform and the browser-reported WebGL renderer are recorded for this run; allowing SwiftShader does not prove that it was selected. CPU throttling is a lab stress condition, not a physical phone measurement. JS heap excludes GPU and browser-process memory. Frame submission time is CPU work, not GPU completion.
